actions.name: inscrutable
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name monster]]{monster} is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the [[lookup @name monster]]{monster}'s intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The sphinx is a 12th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). It requires no material components to cast its spells. The sphinx has the following cleric spells prepared: Cantrips (at will): [[/item .n9pJzTDsAwQxJVRl]]{sacred flame}, [[/item .8zT7njvqbpXs4Cel]]{spare the dying}, [[/item .MUO1uYN7JR1hm4dR]]{thaumaturgy} 1st level (4 slots): [[/item .arzCrMRgcNiQuh43]]{command}, [[/item .Mzh95utKDPIrjiH8]]{detect evil and good}, [[/item .ghXTfe7sgCbgf1Q8]]{detect magic} 2nd level (3 slots): [[/item .F0GsG0SJzsIOacwV]]{lesser restoration}, [[/item .CylBa7jR8DSbo8Z3]]{zone of truth} 3rd level (3 slots): [[/item .15Fa6q1nH27XfbR8]]{dispel magic}, [[/item .gopnZvS0c2jD5FP8]]{tongues} 4th level (3 slots): [[/item .pxpb2eOB6bv4phAf]]{banishment}, [[/item .da0a1t2FqaTjRZGT]]{freedom of movement} 5th level (2 slots): [[/item .5e1xTohkzqFqbYH4]]{flame strike}, [[/item .WzvJ7G3cqvIubsLk]]{greater restoration} 6th level (1 slot): [[/item .mgFqi0ev8f7Ut19y]]{heroes' feast}

actions.name: roar
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} emits a magical roar. Each time it roars before finishing a long rest, the roar is louder and the effect is different, as detailed below. Each creature within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=YEy36H064rrzAAxY]] feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and able to hear the roar must make a saving throw. First Roar. Each creature that fails a [[/save activity=YEy36H064rrzAAxY]] saving throw is &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=YEy36H064rrzAAxY]]. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Roar. Each creature that fails a [[/save activity=bw7Ol7mkkyDDH3LD]] saving throw is &Reference[deafened] and &reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=bw7Ol7mkkyDDH3LD]]. A frightened creature is &Reference[paralyzed] and can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Third Roar. Each creature makes a [[/save activity=euc6EMlISPKQtmY5]] saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes [[/damage average activity=euc6EMlISPKQtmY5]] damage and is knocked &Reference[prone]{prone}. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.

actions.name: cast a spell
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts a spell from its list of prepared spells, using a spell slot as normal.

actions.name: magic weapons
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: teleport
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=nfaYtrEmylWmLluh]] to an unoccupied space it can see.
